style: Say with lively energy, like a friendly game show host
lines: Open a folder and read the five cards. Then tap Choose this issue.
Tap a card, then tap Make a motif. Watch, then stand up and try it.
Change the poses, the dynamic or the pathway until it feels like the card.
Pick a form, then drag a motif onto each slot.
Tap Play dance to watch the whole piece.
Tap Show viewers. Four people will watch and say what they think it is about.
All four viewers named your issue.
Nobody named the issue yet. Try putting a picture motif where they will see it most.
